ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) surface area with sparse high-intensity (white) pixels constituting approximately 3-5% of the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous dark-toned region across the entire visible surface. Discrete white pixel clusters and linear streaks are distributed across both lobes, with a slightly higher density on the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible V-shaped central notch with an approximate angle of 95 degrees and a defined vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations visible along the trailing edge with peaks of varying amplitude (1-4 pixels) relative to the boundary line.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex sweep along the trailing edges of both lobes, transitioning to slightly tapered distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Several circular high-contrast (white) pixel clusters distributed across the dark field, notably in the upper-mid region of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous unaligned linear white streaks of varying lengths (10-30 pixels) scattered across the ventral surface of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive accumulation of white scarring marks including both circular clusters and elongated linear streaks on the dark base color.
other_distinctive_markers: A small, irregular dark-pixel protrusion is visible at the terminal tip of the right fluke lobe.
